theme_and_archetype.rationale: Explicit user request for 'matrix 3d style', cyberpunk, green/cyan accents on black. Needs to feel like a live cryptographic command center.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter uppercase text-primary font-bold
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight text-white uppercase

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Terminal / Command Center grid. High density of information grouped in strict technical borders.

grid_system.borders: border-collapse style, with bright 1px green borders to signify system blocks.

global_effects: CRT Scanlines: A fixed pointer-events-none overlay with a repeating linear gradient of 1px black/transparent lines at 10% opacity.
Matrix Digital Rain: A pure HTML5 Canvas running in the background behind everything, rendering falling green characters.

buttons.style: Cyberpunk terminal button. Hard edges, no border-radius.

images.description: Abstract green digital pattern. Use this as a low-opacity overlay (mix-blend-screen) inside the Witness Nodes cards or consensus visualizer.
Wireframe sphere texture. Use as inspiration or direct map for the 3D Earth globe if a texture map is preferred over wireframe geometry.
Space satellite rendering. Use in the Witness Ledger / Satellites section to represent BOM, Himawari-8, etc.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FRAMEWORK & THEME: Implement a Dark Mode only, Matrix-Cyberpunk aesthetic using React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. The UI should resemble a hacker's terminal or a high-end cryptographic command center.

2. MATRIX RAIN CANVAS: Implement a global background canvas (`z-index: -10`) that draws falling green characters (the classic Matrix digital rain effect). Keep opacity subtle (e.g., 0.15) so it doesn't overpower text.

3. 3D HERO VISUAL (CRITICAL): Use `react-three-fiber` and `drei` to render a 3D Earth globe. Use a `<sphereGeometry>` with a `<meshBasicMaterial wireframe color='#00FF41' />` to give it a holographic look. Add 4 smaller orbiting objects (boxes or spheres) representing the 4 satellites (BOM, Himawari-8, GOES-16, Meteosat), with cyan/green glowing materials. Position this 3D canvas prominently in the hero section alongside or behind the main typography.

4. ANIMATED COUNTERS: Use `framer-motion` or React count-up hooks for the live-ticking engines. The values (e.g., Engine 365-Days: 37,445,846) should constantly increment rapidly in real-time to simulate active cryptographic processing.

5. DATA CARDS (WITNESS NODES): Create 4 distinct cards for the satellites. Include their names, 'VERIFIED' glowing badges, live hash strings (random hex codes updating via interval), and use the `satellite_image` provided in the media section.

6. MINTING CERTIFICATE: Design a prominent, bordered section for the Genesis Timestamp (2026-04-23T07:53:50.5144990+10:00). Make it look like a cryptographic cryptographic ledger entry with glowing borders.

7. GLITCH EFFECTS: Apply CSS-based glitch animations to the H1 ('Atmospheric Truth Layer v1.0.0-minted') and key metrics. Use keyframes to slightly shift text shadow (red/cyan) and translate randomly.
8. SERIES A SECTION: Present the financial metrics ($2.5M ask, $12.5M post-money, $3.18M Year 1 revenue) in a highly technical 'data readout' format rather than a standard corporate layout.
9. SCANLINES OVERLAY: Add a `pointer-events-none` `div` covering the viewport with a CSS repeating linear gradient to simulate CRT monitor scanlines.
10. FOOTER: Center the quote 'The sky doesn't lie. Satellites don't sleep. Math doesn't break.' in glowing cyan text.
11. NO SHADCN COMPONENTS: Do not rely on soft Shadcn cards. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for harsh, 1px bordered, square-cornered elements.
12. Ensure all interactive and data-displaying elements have a `data-testid` attribute.
